colors.rules: White base, Baby Blue (#89CFF0) for accents/buttons, deep charcoal (#0A0A0A) for text. High contrast is mandatory. Baby blue should be used for interactions, kinetic elements, and marquee backgrounds. Do not use generic full-screen gradients.

typography.rules: Use Outfit for headings with tight tracking (tracking-tighter) and weights ranging from light (300) to bold (700) depending on hierarchy. Use Manrope for body text with relaxed line height (leading-relaxed). Avoid Inter for headings. Use fluid typography scaling, max text-6xl for hero.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' (Crystal variant: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px border-white/20) for the sticky nav. Use solid, crisp edges for cards with subtle hover lift and shadow.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for sections. Use gap-8 or gap-12 for bento grids.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use Grid Borders style for the services list or footer to expose the skeleton.
visual_enhancers.motion: Premium motion is key. Use framer-motion for line-by-line masked reveal on the hero headline. Subtle parallax on hero image. Staggered entrance for bento grids and service lists. Use lenis for smooth scrolling.
visual_enhancers.marquee: Editorial marquee ribbon, very slow smooth drift, pale baby blue background with dark text, wide gaps (gap-24).

layouts.hero: Kinetic hero. Split or overlapping layout with large masked typography. Subtle parallax image moment.
layouts.services: Numbered manifesto chapters or a technical grid (Grid Borders) to list out the 8 services (websites, web tools, apps, web apps, programs, custom tools, automations, custom digital solutions).
layouts.portfolio: Clean, large typography placeholder 'Our work is coming soon' with a subtle grain or minimalist aesthetic.
layouts.about: Founder story layout. Asymmetric bento grid mixing text blocks and a portrait image.
layouts.contact: Form on one side, large 'Let's Talk' typography and contact/calendar links on the other.
layouts.general: Mobile-first, asymmetric bento grids (Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with varied spans) to break standard patterns.

components.navigation: Sticky glass header (z-50) with Logo, Links (Home, Services, Portfolio, About, Contact), and a Baby Blue pill-shaped CTA.
components.footer: Massive footer (py-24 or py-32) with dark background (#0A0A0A) and light text, contrasting the main light theme. Include a giant 'KNDP' text (text-[10vw]).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), solid baby blue bg with dark or white text (check contrast). Hover states must have a subtle scale and color shift.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized inputs. Clean 1px bottom border (flushed inputs) or subtly rounded inputs. Never use native raw inputs.

images.description: Abstract white building under blue sky

media.rules: No placeholders. Max height 80vh on mobile. Use subtle masking or clipping on images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts (Outfit, Manrope) via Google Fonts in index.html.
Install framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee, react-router-dom, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Build standard multi-page structure using React Router.
Apply smooth scrolling (Lenis) at the root level.
Implement masked line-by-line reveal for 'We Build Whatever You Need' in Hero.
Strictly DO NOT mention 'AI' anywhere. This is a massive rule.
Override default generic Shadcn styles to match the agency premium aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs (AI slop).
Create depth through layered design elements and z-index hierarchy.
Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Do not center align the app container text.
Use pill-shaped buttons with clear interaction animations.
Add micro-animations to all interactive elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use provided image URLs.
